about_the_game:
Take charge of your future in Prolific Mindset, a captivating life sim where financial wisdom and discipline pave the way to greatness. Strategize to save, invest, and build lasting wealth while crafting routines that transform your daily life. Connect with a passionate community and shape your legacy in this vibrant, growth-driven world!

Prolific Tools: Your in-game edge—streamlined apps to analyze stocks, master budgeting, and dig into research with ease.

 

Share & Grow Together: Unite with passionate peers to exchange ideas, collaborate, and elevate your abilities in a dynamic hub.

Learning Hub: Premier Knowledge Vault: A dynamic community hub packed with the finest insights and strategies to fuel your success.

 

Nostalgic Playground" Treasure-filled world for '90s and early 2000s babies, packed with hidden Easter eggs that reimagine iconic moments for an exciting, nostalgic quest.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Headphones recommended for immersive audio experience
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • VR Support: Gamepad support enabled
  • Additional Notes: Best experienced with headphones and a focused mindset

short_description: Discover a sanctuary where growth happens naturally. Learn real strategies for money, health, and lasting habits without timers, without penalties. Connect with strivers worldwide. Build momentum daily.
